title: MPD Psycho
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Detective Yosuke Kobayashi hunts a serial killer who dismembers victims and sends him his girlfriend mutilated but alive. He kills the murderer, develops dissociative identity disorder and later works as a detective under the personality Kazuhiko Amamiya, while a violent personality, Shinji Nishizono, also surfaces. New killers bearing barcodes in their eyes lead to Gakuso, a shadowy organization engineering personalities, and a conspiracy reaching Japan's Minister of Justice.
life_message: Identity is fragile and can be manipulated by those in power; the story asks whether a self can be one's own at all.

content.note: Dismemberment, mutilation and serial murder; the hero's girlfriend is mutilated yet kept alive (Wikipedia). Reviewer calls it very graphic and unflinching about murder (Anime UK News); MU Blood and Gore, Mutilation, Amputee/s.
Psychological horror, serial killers, human experiments and conspiracies (Wikipedia; MU Dark Ambience, Psychopath/s; AniList Body Horror).
Nudity, including full-frontal nudity on some covers (Anime UK News; AniList and MU Nudity tags); MangaDex 'erotica'; MU Sadomasochism (1 vote). Sex is not the core of the story.
Gakuso controls a teen with numbered pills ('candies') (Wikipedia); MU Drug/s, Smoking.
Dissociative identity disorder at the core; MU Suicide/s, Self-Harm and Mental Illness tags (Wikipedia; MU; AniList Dissociative Identities).
Copycat killers and vigilante murder shown within a horror frame.

dominant: Fractured identity; state and corporate manipulation of persons; violent psychological horror

frames.aligns: Exposes contempt for human dignity, such as a man engineered as an organ donor.
frames.concerns: Extreme gore, nudity and a nihilistic frame; vigilante killing.

folkways.japan: The conspiracy involving Japan's Minister of Justice and an organization engineering citizens reflects Japanese seinen suspicion of hidden state power, described as context.

delivery.evidence: No source checked comments on how the message is delivered; carried by plot per entry summary (to verify)
delivery.note: Its concern with manipulated identity is carried by the conspiracy plot around Gakuso.

winners_losers: Gakuso and corrupt officials hold power for much of the story; victims and personalities are pawns. Sympathy goes to Machi, Sasayama and the hunted hosts.
